attrs.evidence: Found by the canonical removal test rather than by review, which is the reason it is worth recording as a method and not only as a fix. scripts/asr-min-graph.mjs blinds one node or edge type at a time and re-runs the real gate; deleting EVERY argument-assumption edge in the tree cost zero refusals and zero failed checks. §1 required each `assumption_ref` to RESOLVE — a rule about the entries present and no rule about the ones absent. The live consequence: FED-1PA-DEC was PROVED, its only argument rested on ASM-D-FINITE and ASM-GAMMA-FINITE, and the claim record declared no assumptions at all. Third member of a family with INC-R51-ARG-EVIDENCE-UNRESOLVED and INC-R52-REVERSE-INDEX-DRIFT: each time the gate checked the shape of what was written and not the presence of what was owed.
attrs.prior_art: This project’s own removal discipline, applied to its ontology for the first time. GPT-5.6’s adjudication §11 specified the canonical removal test; the test found this before it found anything about the vocabulary it was written to evaluate.
attrs.statement: Every assumption an argument rests on is carried by the claim it concludes, and every assumption a claim declares is named by the argument that establishes it.
